			WITH usage_rows AS (
			WITH
			conversations AS (
				SELECT DISTINCT
					conversation_id
				FROM
					conversation_d
				WHERE
					agent_user_id <> ''
					AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Additional filters
			),
			conversation_events AS (
				SELECT DISTINCT
					agent_user_id,
					conversation_id,
					conversation_start_time,
					event_type,
					event_name,
					event_id
				FROM
					conversation_event_d
				WHERE
					agent_user_id <> ''
					AND ((conversation_start_time >= ?) AND (conversation_start_time < ?)) -- Additional filters
			)
			SELECT
				agent_user_id AS agent_user_id,
				conversation_id AS conversation_id,

tart_time,

				event_name AS event_name,
				event_id AS event_id

				conversations

			)

			FROM usage_rows
			
			"}
